title: How to stop doomscrolling without quitting: come back down instead.

copy.instagram_caption:
How to stop doomscrolling without quitting: come back down instead.

Deleting apps and 30-day resets are all or nothing. They rarely last, and when they slip you feel worse than before.

Try something smaller. When a feed winds you up, breathe in through your nose, add a second short breath on top, then let it all out in one long sigh. One or two rounds is often enough.
